title: Damped SDOF free-decay logarithmic decrement
source: Classical damped oscillator closed form: m u¨ + c u˙ + k u = 0 with m=1, c=0.4, k=4; logarithmic decrement delta=2*pi*zeta/sqrt(1-zeta^2), zeta=c/(2 sqrt(k m))=0.1. The time grid places two successive peaks at one and two damped periods.

quantities.quantity: successive positive peak amplitude ratio exp(delta)
quantities.reason: The exact ratio is exp(delta)=exp(zeta*omega_n*T_d); dt=T_d/1000 makes the average-acceleration amplitude error O(1e-6) per cycle, so 2e-5 includes the fixed-step phase and amplitude error without widening the physical reference.
